abilities.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent

effects.caveat: Not modeled: the coordinated Arcane Projections themselves — the bar shows the 20s window they fire in, not the individual hits.
_curatorNotes: gcsim burst.go: burstInit subscribes to OnEnemyHit while `silent-contemplation` is up (20*60 from burstHitmark+1); requires the hitter to be the ACTIVE character; burstICDKey 3*60; c.projections capped at 4 per burst; the projection lands projectionHitmark=30f after the triggering hit, with Mult burstProjection[9]=1.8 of the TRIGGERING character’s ATK and Element = char.Base.Element.
`scaling`/`stat` are a stand-in: the planner scales on the HOLDER’s stat and this scales on the triggering character’s. `element` is omitted because it varies with who triggered it.

⚓⚓ IT APPLIES NO ELEMENT, AND THAT IS SETTLED (⚓ Nate, 2026-08-18) — ⛔ do not author an `application[]` here, and ⛔ do not re-open this from the gcsim source alone. gcsim gives the projection no `Durability` (burst.go:157, cons.go:49) while EVERY other hit in the file carries 25, and Nate confirmed in game: an Arcane Projection deals Elemental DMG matching the active character’s element, applies NO elemental gauge, and causes NO reactions. So the aura lane staying silent under a Nicole burst is the tool being RIGHT, not a gap — which is also why no caveat says so (the caveat guide’s test is "would a player be misled", and they would not).

⚠️ Consequence, and it is deliberate: with no `application[]` the effect is not armed as a proc (`sim/procs.ts` accepts only a damage effect that carries one), so `trigger.armedFor` is NOT authored either — an arming window on an effect nothing can arm is the partially-wired data `orphanedSchema` cannot see. The 20s lives on the ability as `activeDuration`, where a reader can see it.

⚠️ `duration: 20` was removed from this effect in the same pass. On a `damage` effect nothing reads it — the buff path’s `.duration` accesses satisfy `orphanedSchema` by key name, which is that guard’s documented blind spot.
⚠️ NOT modelled: the 4-projections-per-burst cap, and gcsim’s per-character projection hitbox offsets (a positional claim, the class docs/gauge-round-L5e.md refuses to grow a vocabulary for).
Nicole’s own initial burst hit (570.2% ATK Pyro at T10) is on-field self damage, not a team-facing capability — not authored as an effect; its Pyro is the ability-level `application[]`.

⚠️ 2026-08-18, SURFACE not content: the `caveat` on this effect reaches NO reader — `collectSlotCaveats` (timeline/slotCaveats.ts:58-67) reads `caveat` on ability/passive/constellation hosts only, and `Effect` has no rendered caveat channel. Of this burst's two caveat strings only the ABILITY-level Hexerei one renders (in the Notes panel, and the whole panel is behind band B's Notes button and mutually exclusive with the aura log). So "the bar shows the 20s window, not the individual Arcane Projections" is currently told to nobody. ⚠️ The claim itself is still accurate and is worth keeping somewhere: with no `application[]` this effect is not armed as a proc at all (`procEffects` at sim/procs.ts:156-159 rejects a damage effect carrying none), which is the SETTLED decision recorded above — so what a reader sees is the `activeDuration: 20` span and nothing inside it.

abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the Hexerei Secret Rite — with 2 or more Hexerei in the party, Arcane Projections triggered by Hexerei members deal extra DMG equal to 300% of her ATK.
_curatorNotes: activeDuration 20 authored 2026-08-18: the burst "switches to Silent Contemplation mode" and gcsim holds `silent-contemplation` for 20*60 from burstHitmark+1 (burst.go:113). ⚠️ NOT `duration` and NOT a summon — nothing is left in the world; it is a mode on Nicole, which is exactly what `activeDuration` is for (see the shield/summon split). Without it the Q bar was an instant and the window the Arcane Projections live in was invisible.

HEXEREI Secret Rite (count-gated). gcsim asc.go:111-123 hexereiOnProjection: requires Nicole IsHexerei AND GetHexereiCount() >= 2 AND the triggering character IsHexerei; returns c.TotalAtk()*3, applied as AttackInfo.FlatDmg on the burst projection (burst.go:164) and on C1's Arcane Projection: Unity (cons.go:56).

Pure damage-magnitude enhancement to an existing hit (flat add, no new instance, no stat change) — recorded, not authored as an effect. Lives in factionBonuses as a description-only Secret Rite entry plus this caveat.
abilities.description:
As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode.
In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them.
This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode.

It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...

passives.name: Methexis

effects.caveat: Not modeled: at C6 the upgrade no longer reverts when a character leaves the field, so the whole party holds it at once.
_curatorNotes: A1 Methexis: gcsim asc.go a1Buff[ATK]=300, granted on OnCharacterSwap to the INCOMING character after a 3*60 delay, and immediately when that character IsHexerei. The upgrade lasts the receiver’s remaining Grace of Kenosis window (a1UpgradeBuff with dur -1); asc.go deletes it from the OUTGOING character unless C6 (c6DeleteA1OnSwap).

↻ 2026-08-18: the delay and both waivers are AUTHORED now (`onFieldDelay`), where this used to be a flat active-target buff starting at the cast with the timing only in prose. ⚓ The Hexerei waiver is a property of the RECEIVER and is NOT count-gated — gcsim checks a bare `char.IsHexerei` with no GetHexereiCount() call, so a lone Hexerei teammate still skips the wait. ⛔ Not a `teamFaction` condition.

⚓ The C6 waiver is the second half of the same field: cons.go c6OnUpgrade upgrades every other member the moment Nicole’s own upgrades, so nobody waits. Composed as one `any`, which is why the waiver is a Condition rather than a bespoke faction key.

⚠️ The revert-on-swap-out needed no authoring: an active-target buff is already sliced per on-field segment, so leaving the field ends the slice, and only the LAST segment runs to the buff’s own end. ⚠️ NOT modelled: at C6 it stops reverting, so all four members hold it at once — a single active-target effect cannot say that, and the caveat carries it.

⚠️ 2026-08-18: "the caveat carries it" is NOT TRUE as things stand — that caveat sits on this EFFECT, and an effect-level `caveat` reaches no reader (`collectSlotCaveats`, timeline/slotCaveats.ts:58-67, reads `caveat` on ability/passive/constellation hosts only; `Effect` has no rendered caveat channel). The C6 no-revert divergence is currently disclosed nowhere. ⚠️⚠️ If it is moved to the passive's own `caveat` to fix that, KEEP the "at C6" wording in the sentence: `slotCaveats` gates a caveat by its host ENTRY's constellation level, and a PASSIVE has no entry level, so the note will show at C0 too — the prefix is the only thing that makes it honest there. ⛔ Do not solve it by moving the text onto the C6 constellation entry: the buff being described is the A1's, and this file already keeps A1 and C6 separate for that reason.

passives.description:
For 20s after unleashing the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**, Nicole will continuously "observe" the other current active party members. After the observed character has remained on the field for 3s, their **Grace of Kenosis** is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, increasing their ATK by an additional 300. If the observed character is a Hexerei character, Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis straight away.
When characters other than Nicole who have Guidance of Theosis leave the field, their effect reverts to Grace of Kenosis.

passives.name: Philokalia

effects.caveat: Shown at her own skill and burst casts; in game the upgrade instead triggers whenever a nearby active party member's Elemental DMG hits an opponent.
_curatorNotes: A4 Philokalia: gcsim asc.go a4Init upgrades Nicole's own buff on active-member elemental hit for c6SelfBuffDur = 8s (C0). Self-only; boosts Nicole's ATK (marginally her shield/Grace scaling on subsequent casts). At C6 the self-upgrade duration is -1 (matches remaining Grace window).

⚠️ `source: ‘team’` is one step wider than gcsim, which requires the hitter to be the ACTIVE character (asc.go a4Init: `ae.Info.ActorIndex != c.Core.Player.Active()`). `onHit` has no `‘active’` source, and adding one for a self-buff would be the trap the mark-triggered round names: an entity carries its OWNER’s id, so an id test alone counts a summon’s tick as its owner’s. The over-fire is that an off-field summon’s elemental hit upgrades Nicole; it costs her +300 ATK on herself a little early.

↻ 2026-08-18: ⚠️⚠️ THE DIVERGENCE ABOVE IS WRONG IN THE OTHER DIRECTION — there is no over-fire, because `source` is never read on this path. A character-hosted `onHit` buff window is pooled by `getCharacterEffectsForOnHit` and filtered by `evalTriggerFilter` alone; `onHitTriggerMatches` — the only function that answers `source` / `damageType` / `abilityType` — is called at exactly three sites, none of them a character buff pool (utils/buffWindows.ts:1049 is the ARTIFACT branch, sim/stacks.ts:414 and :532, sim/procs.ts:396). So both `source: 'team'` and `damageType: 'elemental'` are inert here. What actually draws: this effect is a PASSIVE-hosted `onHit` with no `trigger.abilityType`, which `getCharacterEffectsForOnHit` (utils/effectCollection.ts:352-366) excludes from the N/CA/P pass outright and admits for castType skill|burst — so the bar is anchored at NICOLE'S OWN skill and burst casts (`cast.fieldStart`, buffWindows.ts:1676) and fires off nobody's hits at all. The effect-level `caveat` beside this note states exactly that and is the accurate description; ⚠️ it also reaches no reader, being effect-level (slotCaveats.ts:58-67). ⛔ Do not "fix" the divergence by narrowing `source` to a value that does not exist — the gap is that the character onHit pools do not consult the trigger at all, and it is corpus-wide (rubric P2), not Nicole's.

⚠️ NOT modelled: at C6 `c6SelfBuffDur()` returns -1, so this self-upgrade lasts Nicole’s remaining Grace window instead of 8s. A duration has no `constellationScaling`, and a second C6-gated copy would be collapsed by the one-bar-per-stat rule — the same reason the C6 party-wide +300 is not authored as its own effect.

_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go c1Init: OnEnemyHit by active char, c1ICDKey=6*60, Mult:6 (600%) of the triggering character's ATK, element = char.Base.Element, lands projectionHitmark=30f later. Independent of the burst — fires whenever the active char hits, not gated on Silent Contemplation.

scaling stat 'atk' is a stand-in for the triggering character's ATK; element omitted (varies). This damage effect does not itself derive an offFieldDamage capability (that comes from the burst coordinatedAttack tag at C0).

HEXEREI Secret Rite also applies here: cons.go:56 passes FlatDmg = hexereiOnProjection(char), so with 2+ Hexerei in the party a Unity projection triggered by a Hexerei member gains flat DMG equal to 300% of Nicole's ATK. conditions authored 2026-08-18 because a constellation effect was NOT gated by its entry’s `constellationLevel` anywhere in the planner — `buffWindows` collected every constellation effect and gated only on the effect’s own `conditions` (Bennett C1/C4/C6 all author theirs). Without it this drew at C0. ↻ SAME DAY, later: the constellation-gating round (`a0f0b2f`) fixed that at the source — `effectSourcesAtConstellation` (utils/effectCollection.ts:76-93) drops a locked entry at COLLECTION, so a constellation effect is now gated by its entry everywhere that decides something. This condition is therefore pure duplication and is KEPT deliberately (⛔ do not strip it — it documents intent at the effect, and all 133 such conditions in the corpus were verified to name exactly their own entry's level), but ⛔ do not repeat the claim above: a NEW constellation effect no longer needs one to avoid drawing at C0.
⚓ Applies no element either, same ruling and same source as the burst’s Arcane Projection (⚓ Nate, 2026-08-18) — the two stand or fall together, and both are settled. ⛔ No `application[]`.

constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**: **Grace of Kenosis** increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while **Guidance of Theosis** decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.
_curatorNotes: ⚓ The shield half of this C2 is CO-OP ONLY and is deliberately UNMODELLED (2026-08-18) — Kirara C2 is the house form. "Nearby active party members" is plural only in co-op, where each player has their own on-field character; in a single-player party there is exactly one active character and the skill's own Shield of Blazing Light (gcsim `Target: -1`, player-wide) already covers them. gcsim implements NO shield for this constellation at all — `cons.go` c2 is the +300 ATK buff and the RES ticker, both authored below. ⛔ It was briefly authored as a `target: 'team'` shield Effect and that was WRONG in two ways: the corpus renders this phrase as `target: 'active'` everywhere else (Illuga, Aino), and a team-target shield made the Team Builder claim Nicole shields the whole party at C2. See docs/constellation-shield-gap.md §7.3.

constellations.description:
When nearby party members have their **Grace of Kenosis** upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.
